items.raw_excerpt: Sept 14 : Former Southampton midfielder Sofiane Boufal has joined Libyan Premier League side Al-Ittihad on a free transfer, the Tripoli-based side said on Monday.The 32-year-old Moroccan moves to Libya after spells with clubs in France, England, Spain, Belgium and Qatar, as Al-Ittihad look to bolster their sq
items.summary_en: Moroccan player Sofiane Boufal has joined Libyan club Al-Ittihad for free. He is 32 and has played in France, England, Spain, Belgium and Qatar. The club wants to make its squad stronger.
items.summary_ko: 모로코 선수 소피안 부팔이 리비아 클럽 알이티하드에 자유계약으로 합류했습니다. 서른두 살인 그는 프랑스, 영국, 스페인, 벨기에, 카타르에서 뛰어본 경력이 있습니다. 클럽은 팀 전력을 강화하려는 모양입니다.

items.title_original: Boufal embarks on new adventure with Libya's Al-Ittihad

items.raw_excerpt: Ese Aumalesulu and his daughters Tara, 13, and Sophia, 9, won for their take on Annie Crummer’s version of 'See What Love Can Do' by Eric Clapton.
items.summary_en: Ese Aumalesulu and his daughters Tara, 13, and Sophia, 9, won a music contest. They played their own version of 'See What Love Can Do' by Annie Crummer and Eric Clapton. The family says music is their shared language.
items.summary_ko: 에세 아우마레술루와 그의 딸들인 열세 살 타라, 아홉 살 소피아가 음악 콘테스트에서 우승했습니다. 세 사람은 애니 크러머와 에릭 클랩턴의 'See What Love Can Do'를 자신들만의 방식으로 연주했습니다. 가족은 음악이 함께 소통하는 언어라고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Auckland family trio wins the Kiwi Cover Song Contest
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 가족 3인조가 커버송 콘테스트에서 우승
items.title_original: 'Music is our language' - Auckland family trio win the Kiwi Cover Song Contest

items.raw_excerpt: Óbidos is a very well-preserved medieval town, around an hour north of Lisbon. And to be honest, it’s one of my favourite places to visit in Portugal. It has a specific charm and really interesting history.
items.summary_en: Obidos is a very well-preserved medieval town, about an hour north of Lisbon. It has a special charm and a really interesting history. It is one of the author's favourite places in Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 오비두스는 리스본에서 북쪽으로 약 한 시간 거리에 있는, 보존 상태가 아주 좋은 중세 마을이다. 이곳은 특별한 매력과 흥미로운 역사를 지니고 있다. 저자가 포르투갈에서 가장 좋아하는 곳 중 하나다.
items.title_en: Obidos: Portugal's Town of Queens

items.raw_excerpt: Show da final foi remarcado para 12 de dezembro, na Caixa Cultural Brasília
items.summary_en: The Rádio Nacional Music Festival moves its final show to December 12 at Caixa Cultural in Brasília. It got 1,512 song entries this year, a new record. From September 30, online voting starts for the 50 semifinal songs.
items.summary_ko: 제17회 라디오 나시오날 음악 축제의 결승 공연이 12월 12일 브라질리아의 카이샤 컬쳐럴에서 열립니다. 올해는 전국에서 1512곡이 출품되어 역대 최다 기록을 세웠습니다. 9월 30일부터 준결승 진출곡 50곡에 대한 온라인 투표가 시작됩니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Attention should be turned to bringing passenger rail to the South Island after the success of Auckland's City Rail Link (CRL), a train advocate says.
items.summary_en: Auckland's City Rail Link received billions of dollars. A train supporter says it is time to bring passenger rail to the South Island too. He says southern New Zealand needs the same attention.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드의 시티 레일 링크에 수십억 달러가 투입됐지만, 남섬 철도에는 한 푼도 쓰이지 않았다고 한 기차 옹호론자가 지적했다. 오클랜드의 성공을 계기로 이제 남섬에도 여객 철도를 도입해야 한다는 주장이다.
items.title_en: Auckland's rail got billions, South Island got nothing
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 철도에 수십억 달러, 남섬 철도엔 한 푼도 없다
items.title_original: Billions for Auckland's CRL but 'not a brass razoo' for South Island rail

items.raw_excerpt: A man who left his job because of Covid-19 vaccine requirements, and later fell into significant arrears on his home loan, has been awarded $500 in compensation from the bank.
items.summary_en: A man in New Zealand lost his job because of Covid-19 vaccine requirements. He fell behind on his home loan payments. A bank must now pay him $500 in compensation.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드의 한 남성이 코로나19 백신 규정 때문에 직장을 그만둔 뒤 집 대출을 갚는 데 어려움을 겪었습니다. 은행이 이 남성에게 500달러를 배상해야 한다는 판정이 나왔습니다.
items.title_en: $500 compensation for man who gave up job over vaccine rules
items.title_ko: 백신 규정 때문에 일을 그만둔 남성, 은행으로부터 500달러 배상받아
items.title_original: $500 compensation for man who may lose house after giving up job over vaccine rules

items.raw_excerpt: The Wake the Giant Music Festival is facing backlash after headliner Flo Rida, an American rapper, used alcohol props on stage at the sober event in Thunder Bay on Saturday. The annual event aims to create a safe, inclusive environment for hundreds of Indigenous youth from remote northern communities who attend school in the northwestern Ontario city.
items.summary_en: A music festival for Indigenous youth in Thunder Bay apologized after rapper Flo Rida used alcohol-themed props on stage. The festival aims to provide a safe, inclusive environment for youth from remote northern communities.
items.summary_ko: Thunder Bay에서 열린 원주민 청소년을 위한 음악 축제에서 래퍼 Flo Rida가 무대에서 술 관련 소품을 사용해 논란이 되었다. 이 축제는 북부 원격 지역에서 온 청소년들을 위한 안전한 환경을 제공하기 위해 매년 열리고 있다. 주최 측은 공식적으로 사과하며 안전한 환경을 유지하겠다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Music festival apologizes after Flo Rida uses alcohol props at sober event in Thunder Bay
items.title_ko: Thunder Bay에서 열린 소박한 행사에서 Flo Rida가 술 소품을 사용해 음악 축제 사과
items.title_original: Music festival apologizes after Flo Rida uses alcohol props at sober event in Thunder Bay, Ont.

items.raw_excerpt: ROME: Sicily's Catania airport shut down temporarily on Monday (Sep 14) due to volcanic activity on Mount Etna that spewed ash into the sky."Arrivals and departures at Catania Airport are suspended," the airport said in a statement on its website.The airport, that usually services around 12 million p
items.summary_en: Sicily's Catania airport stopped flights on Monday because Mount Etna sent ash into the sky. The airport said arrivals and departures are suspended. It usually serves about 12 million passengers.
items.summary_ko: 시칠리아의 카타니아 공항이 에트나 화산이 하늘로 화산재를 뿜어내며 월요일에 운항을 일시 중단했다. 공항은 도착과 출발 편이 모두 중단됐다고 공지했다. 이 공항은 보통 약 1,200만 명의 승객이 이용한다.
items.title_en: Catania airport suspends flights after Mount Etna volcano erupts
items.title_ko: 시칠리아 카타니아 공항, 에트나 화산 분화로 운항 중단
items.title_original: Italian airport suspends flights due to volcanic activity

items.raw_excerpt: A group representing retirement village residents says it is taking far too long to get a law change that will ensure faster payouts for people who leave.
items.summary_en: A group for retirement village residents says changing the law is taking too long. The change would make payouts faster for people who leave a village. The association wants the government to speed up the process.
items.summary_ko: 실버타운 거주민 단체가 관련 법 개정이 너무 오래 걸린다고 지적했다. 이번 개정은 마을을 떠나는 거주민이 더 빨리 보상을 받을 수 있게 해 주는 내용이다. 단체는 정부가 절차를 서둘러 달라고 요구했다.
items.title_en: Retirement village law change is taking too long

items.raw_excerpt: El equipo chileno de Copa Davis, liderado por Nicolás Massú, tuvo este lunes su segunda jornada de entrenamientos para la serie contra España. En el Court Central del Nacional trabajaron Alejandro Tabilo, Cristian Garin, Tomás Barrios y Matías Soto; además, los acompañaron Nicolás Jarry, Benjamín Torrealba, Nicolás Villalón y el juvenil Benjamín Pérez.
items.summary_en: Chile's Davis Cup team, led by coach Nicolas Massu, had its second training day on Monday for the series against Spain. Players practiced at the National Central Court in Santiago. The team will face Spain in the Davis Cup.
items.summary_ko: 니콜라스 마수 감독이 이끄는 데이비스컵 칠레 대표팀이 스페인과의 시리즈를 앞두고 월요일 두 번째 훈련을 진행했습니다. 선수들은 산티아고 국립 중앙 코트에서 훈련에 임했고, 스페인과의 데이비스컵 경기를 앞두고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Chile's Davis Cup team held its second training day for the Spain series
items.title_ko: 데이비스컵 칠레 대표팀, 스페인전 대비 두 번째 훈련 가져
items.title_original: Chile tuvo su segunda jornada de prácticas para la serie contra España en la Copa Davis

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland and Wellington both recorded the longest period it has ever taken a property to sell in August last month, and Wellington had its lowest-ever August sales count.
items.summary_en: In August, it took longer than ever to sell a home in Auckland and Wellington. Wellington also had its lowest August home sales count ever. Home buyers in both cities are waiting and the property market is slowing.
items.summary_ko: 지난 8월 오클랜드와 웰링턴에서 집이 팔리기까지 걸린 기간이 역대 가장 길었습니다. 웰링턴의 8월 주택 판매 수도 역대 최저였습니다. 두 도시 모두 부동산 시장이 크게 위축되고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Auckland and Wellington home sales hit record lows

items.title_original: Auckland and Wellington hit record property market lows

items.raw_excerpt: Slowly but surely, the Riviera Maya has begun to regain the clear turquoise waters that underpin much of its tourist appeal, following several months of massive sargassum arrivals along the Quintana Roo coast.
items.summary_en: Clear turquoise waters are returning along the Riviera Maya in Quintana Roo. This follows several months of heavy sargassum seaweed arrivals on the coast. The cleaner water is good news for the region's tourism.
items.summary_ko: 킨타나로오 연안의 리비에라마야에서 여러 달 동안 이어진 대규모 사르가슴 해조 유입 이후, 맑고 푸른 바닷물이 서서히 회복되고 있다. 리비에라마야의 관광 매력을 좌우하는 이 깨끗한 물은 현지 관광업에 좋은 소식이다.
items.title_en: Riviera Maya regains its color as sargassum subsides

items.raw_excerpt: The 1888 riverside landmark has been lifted, restored and reimagined as a 75-room hotel, with its heritage buildings reserved for restaurants, bars and public spaces.
items.summary_en: A riverside landmark built in 1888 has been lifted, restored and turned into a 75-room hotel. Its heritage buildings are now restaurants, bars and public spaces. The old Bangkok Custom House has started a new life.
items.summary_ko: 1888년에 강변에 지어진 랜드마크가 들어 올려져 복원된 뒤 75개 객실의 호텔로 다시 태어났습니다. 유서 깊은 건물들은 레스토랑, 바, 공용 공간으로 쓰입니다. 방콕의 옛 세관 건물이 새롭게 럭셔리 호텔로 살아났습니다.
items.title_en: Bangkok's historic Custom House becomes a luxury hotel
items.title_ko: 방콕의 유서 깊은 세관 건물이 럭셔리 호텔로 재탄생

items.raw_excerpt: Volume de precipitações já equivale a três vezes a média mensal para o período.
items.summary_en: September has brought record rainfall to the capital of Sao Paulo. The amount already equals three times the average monthly rain for the period. It is a new monthly record for the city.

items.raw_excerpt: The X Games sports competition is coming to Calgary in February next year. WinSport's Canada Olympic Park will host the three-day event beginning Feb. 19.
items.summary_en: The X Games sports competition is coming to Calgary in February next year. WinSport's Canada Olympic Park will host the three-day event beginning Feb. 19.

items.summary_en: Rakesh Tikait asks Noida farmers to protest harder for land money. Farmers want fair payment for land the government took. Officials are limiting how they can protest.

items.raw_excerpt: Trustees for the site say rising costs and a lack of government funding are threatening its future.
items.summary_en: The Battle of Britain Memorial in Kent may run short of money. Trustees say rising costs and little government help put its future in doubt. The site costs about 240,000 pounds a year to run and depends on visitors and donations.
items.summary_ko: 켄트에 있는 배틀 오브 브리튼 추모 기념관이 자금 부족으로 위기에 빠질 수 있습니다. 운영위원들은 비용 상승과 정부 지원 부족으로 앞날이 불안하다고 말합니다. 이곳은 운영에 연간 약 24만 파운드가 들며 방문객과 기부금에 의존합니다.
items.title_en: Fears grow for future of Battle of Britain memorial

items.raw_excerpt: The Auckland council farms - or parks - have successfully reduced the number of roaming dog attacks on ewes and lambs thanks to six protective llamas that were introduced last year.
items.summary_en: Six llamas now guard Auckland council farms and parks. They have cut roaming dog attacks on ewes and lambs. The llamas were introduced last year.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 시의회가 운영하는 농장과 공원에 라마 6마리가 배치됐다. 방황하는 개들이 어미 양과 새끼 양을 공격하는 일이 크게 줄었다. 라마들은 지난해부터 투입됐다.

items.raw_excerpt: When Brody Thompson finished school, he initially struggled to find a sense of professional purpose until someone suggested he try support work.
items.summary_en: Brody Thompson struggled to find professional purpose after finishing school. Someone suggested he try disability support work, and he found his calling. Men in Riverland are leaving farm and trade work to take jobs in disability care.

items.summary_en: Carucha Fernandez, a former Colo Colo player, came back to the Monumental stadium to watch the match against Deportes Concepcion. He said the visit felt very special.
items.summary_ko: 콜로콜로의 전설적인 선수였던 카루차 페르난데스가 데포르테스 콘셉시온과의 경기를 보기 위해 모뉴멘탈 경기장을 다시 찾았습니다. 그는 이번 방문이 아주 특별하게 느껴졌다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: Former Colo Colo star Carucha Fernandez returns to the stadium
